{{Top}}
'''Class Five infractions''' were one of the five categories of crime outlined in the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] alongside [[Class Four infraction/Legends|Class Four]], [[Class Three infraction/Legends|Class Three]], [[Class Two infraction/Legends|Class Two]] and [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One]] infractions. <ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Crimes in this category included, but were not limited to: 
*Violation of local laws regarding the import and export of goods
*Departure of a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] from a [[Spaceport|spaceport]] without it being fully supplied with [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and the various necessities needed to sustain a long travel
*Lack of enough [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] on a ship to accommodate all its crew and passengers

Being the less serious level of offense in Imperial Law, Class Five infractions often tended to be ignored by less dutiful [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. Standard Imperial punishment for this type of violation ranged from a fine of 500 up to 1.000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GG6" />
